title: Light rings and optical appearances of naked singularities, solitons, and black holes in beyond Horndeski gravity
summary: We investigate the geodesic structure and optical appearance of compact objects with primary scalar hair in shift- and parity-symmetric beyond Horndeski gravity. The analytic solution considered here depends on a theory parameter and a dimensionless mass parameter \cite{Bakopoulos:2023sdm}. For a fixed theory parameter, varying the mass traces a family of static spacetimes that can interpolate between timelike naked singularities, regular solitons, regular black holes, Reissner-Nordström-like black holes, multi-horizon black holes, and Schwarzschild-like black holes.
